# Android read-only emission source fixtures

These four small public source archives preserve the root-principal and receiver
source joins and the isolated local NUL-frame fix. They contain no credential,
retained production programme, native capture or runtime dependency. Tests select
pure definitions only; they never execute an archived module, receiver or bootstrap.
The existing `fixtures/**/*.source -text` rule preserves their exact bytes.

The root mock and UID1000 mock are source-assembly controls, not Linux access
proof. The actual own-process Linux UID1000 PermissionError / UID0 success
scenario remains separate native evidence and must be retained.
